title: Two independent fixes
kind: two changes in two files (suits team mode)
prompt: Two independent changes: (1) inventory.total() must multiply each item's price by its quantity; it currently adds up the prices only. (2) cli.py's main(argv) should accept a --json option and then print the report as one JSON object, {"items": <number of items>, "total": <total>}, instead of the text line. Without --json it prints the text line as now.
